# CGPA Calculator

> A free, regulation-aware SGPA, CGPA and percentage calculator for engineering students in Tamil Nadu, India. Pick your college, department, batch and semester, enter grades once, and SGPA, CGPA and percentage update instantly.

Single-page app: every calculation runs in the browser and results are stored in localStorage. No account, no server, no analytics.

Key facts:

- Curricula follow Anna University regulations and are mapped subject-by-subject for 19 departments (CSE to Robotics) across two grade scales: R2023 and R2025.
- Only Rajalakshmi Engineering College (REC) is live. SSN, RIT, MIT, CEG and SKCET are listed as coming soon.
- SGPA is the credit-weighted average of grade points in one semester.
- CGPA is the credit-weighted average of grade points across every semester.
- Percentage uses the published formula per regulation: (CGPA - 0.75) x 10 for older batches, CGPA x 10 for newer batches.
- Grades U (arrear), SA (shortage of attendance), WD/WC (withdrawal) and mandatory non-credit courses never count toward CGPA.

## Pages

- [CGPA Calculator](https://tams-cgpa-calculator.vercel.app/): Interactive calculator with college, department, batch and semester selection; subject-by-subject grade entry for the current semester, an overall SGPA shortcut for past semesters, and a live CGPA, SGPA and percentage summary.
